name: Kabitirthey Sarodotsab Durga Puja
description: Khidderpore is home to many pujas and Kbirtirthey is one of them thos Puja has a beautiful Durga Pratima every year and the crowd always loves coming here. If you are in Khidderpore this is must visit for the grandeur and colors. This is such a beautiful Puja

name: Udayan Kidderpore
description: This is one of the oldest and most well respected Durga pujas in Khidirpur. If you like traditional idols you will love this pandal. The idol is made beautifully and this is a must visit pandal if you are in Khidderpore. The pandal is simple but well made. So this is a good option.

name: Kidderpore Milan Sangha Club
description: Kidderpore is home to many Puja pandals. These have been organised for many many years. The Milan Sangha Puja is a huge Puja with spacious pandal and a huge pratima. The Puja has been well loved by people it is popuyon the area and should be on your map of pujas to watch.

name: 25 Pally Club
description: Most famous Durga Puja of khidderpore this is theone for which most people travel to the area. This Puja has been a crowd puller for many decades and still remains one of the biggest pujas of the area. If you want to see khidirpur Durga pujas you cannot afford to miss this one.

name: 26 Pally Club
description: Beautiful Maa Durga Pratima in a very simple pandal. The charm of the pratima keeps you enthralled. I would definitely recommend that you look at the pratima next year as every year they do some great work. The pandal is a must visit if you are visiting that part of the city.

name: Khidderpore Pally Saradiya
description: One the most rarest Maa Durga murti in Kolkata. This is a must see Puja if you have never seen such a murti. The pandal is simple but the murti is out of this world it is such a unique design where the children are depicted within the murti and this should be visited every year.

name: Khidderpore Nabarag
description: Khidirpur has many famous Durga Puja pandals. This one is a simple but beautiful pandal with focus on having a huge traditional Maa Durga idol.this should be part of your route if you are visiting that part of the town. The quality of workmanship is just amazing .

name: 74 Pally Club
description: 74 Pally Club always stands out with its creativity and grandeur. The pandal design is unique every year and the idol looks absolutely divine. The detailing in the theme and decorations is praiseworthy, making it a must-visit spot for pandal hoppers. The lighting and cultural programs add to the festive vibe. Though the crowd is usually heavy, the organizers manage it well and ensure smooth movement. Overall, a wonderful experience worth visiting during Durga Puja!

name: 75 Pally Khidderpore
description: Khidderpore 75 Pally Durga Puja is a charming celebration with a traditional vibe. The pandal is beautifully decorated, blending classic themes with modern touches, and the idol is crafted with great attention to detail. The lighting and overall ambience create a festive mood, perfect for family visits.The crowd is manageable for the most part, though it gets a bit congested during peak hours. The arrangements for prasad and offerings are decent, and the volunteers are generally helpful. Overall, it’s a pleasant experience that captures the spirit of the festival.

name: KIDDERPORE SARBOJANIN DURGOTSAB
description: Amazing Durga Maa murti this pandal is just so beautiful to look at. It's very easy to access from the main road and there is enough space to manage crowds. You will definitely enjoy looking at Maa Durga Pratima. I will recommend that you visit them every year they are very well made.
